title: list-extensions shows badly on small screens
body:
`mvn quarkus:list-extensions` is un usable with the added URL. You guys have tiny eyes and big screens. But for me I can't click on the url as it goes on two lines.
I'd recommend we put the URL in a second line.

```

s.io/guides/rest-json-guide
```
